verdict.rationale: Windmill documents recurring CRON schedules for scripts and flows, with error and recovery handlers. It also documents event triggers (webhooks, Kafka, Postgres, SQS, MQTT and more), step retries, and AI agent steps inside flows, so automations can run unattended in the background on a recurring basis, not just as one-off runs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended scheduled or agentic runs in production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A Schedule consists of a Script or Flow, its arguments, a CRON expression that controls the execution frequency and optional Error and Recovery Handlers to deal with failed scheduled executions.
Use schedules, webhooks, emails, HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, GCP, Azure Event Grid and more.
If defined, upon error this step will be retried with a delay and a maximum number of attempts as defined below.
AI Agents steps allow you to integrate AI agents directly into your Windmill flows.
